recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not revert the element to the original CodeableReference(Any) wording for FHIR-45290; any future broadening of recommendation targets or restoration of codeable recommendations should be handled as new OO work.
issue_request: FHIR-45290 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It requested adding a DiagnosticReport recommendation element so diagnostic follow-up recommendations could be represented structurally instead of only in unstructured conclusion text; the resolution specified 0..* with a proposed follow-up action definition and CodeableReference(Any) at the time.
initial_application: FHIR-45290 was applied before this reconciliation. Commit 3b33f2b3108758f826eda9d3204558b9176e3b5b added the element to the DiagnosticReport StructureDefinition as misspelled DiagnosticReport.recomendation with CodeableReference(Resource), and same-issue commit 46f154da38183456495c20b2d1645a9c17268930 did not make a further semantic change to that element.
additional_context: FHIR-54163 later corrected the spelling to DiagnosticReport.recommendation. FHIR-50601 later changed the datatype from CodeableReference to Reference with request-like target resources and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 1e56cc2fdc36253f49d6a8c34eb40976718855b7. The current DiagnosticReport resource is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current source also lists DiagnosticReport.recommendation in the R6 additions ballot note.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current authoritative DiagnosticReport StructureDefinition already contains DiagnosticReport.recommendation with 0..* cardinality, the final singular spelling, and the later accepted Reference datatype and targetProfile list.
